title: Reel round 2
meta: a second, fresh critic · mid-frames of all 54, dog crops at 360 px, five frames across six lenses, cut onsets
gap: Overlays repeated as the way to show a method, where the method should be on the dog: five lenses (05, 24, 40, 44, 53) still left the dog plain, and neighbours shared corner tags and dark panels.
repair: Every lens changes at least 25% of the dog at 360 px; no two lenses within three places share an overlay type; lens 14's dog keeps at least half its area in every frame.
notes: Breaks: 14's dog flipped to a sliver; 38 pasted a card over the dog; 49 removed the person.
25 and 48 both state graphs, and 14 used the same state words.
Captions: the look too small; two "NORA WILLETT" titles; the cut into 17 and the end card had no sound onset.
keep: A sound onset on 53 of 54 cuts; the material language of 17 lenses; the caption bar; the title and end cards; the dog legible as one machine.
done: The five plain dogs get their method on the body (glass planes, a deforming mesh, card thickness and a lamp, depth-tinted planes, silver-gelatin with scratches); corner tags and panels removed or moved onto the dog; 48 shows trust as a level inside the dog and its last reason, 25 a graph tinted by state; 14 at a moment with no turn and numbered drawings; 38 keeps the dog under the red pencil; 49 keeps the person, greyed and out of focus; captions carry the full title and a larger look; a click on every cut and the end card.
